corrections.reason: The existing eval-taint rule uses the $REQ metavariable in $REQ.body.code and does not restrict its identifier to the literal req. ET07's request identifier therefore matches the configured syntactic source pattern.
corrections.initial_observation: The first valid Semgrep run reported one finding for ET07 under both eval-taint rules. The initial oracle had excluded it from binary scores and the evaluator listed it as an out-of-scope match.
